contribution: Methods for empirically analyzing market power, demand and competition in differentiated-product markets (structural empirical industrial organization)
rationale: Recent prizes covered growth and innovation (2025), institutions (2024), labor and gender (2023), banking (2022) and causal inference (2021), so empirical IO is an overdue field. The BLP framework is foundational and widely used in antitrust, merger review and regulation. Its timing fits current policy concern about market concentration. Alternatives include Helpman, Grossman and Melitz for trade theory, and Blanchard and Kiyotaki for macroeconomics.
